arxiv-2201-12393.title: Better Algorithms for Online Bin Stretching via Computer Search
arxiv-2201-12393.creator: Matej Lieskovský
arxiv-2201-12393.description: Abstract Online Bin Stretching , introduced by Azar and Regev [ 1 ] is an assignment problem similar to Online Bin Packing . A sequence of items of size between 0 and 1 arrive and each must be assigned a bin before processing the next item. We are assured that the items fit into m bins of size 1.

arxiv-2308-15947.title: The Uniqueness Theorem for Nonlocal Hydrodynamic Media
arxiv-2308-15947.creator: Christos Mystilidis, George Fikioris, Christos Tserkezis, Guy A. E. Vandenbosch, and Xuezhi Zheng
arxiv-2308-15947.description: Abstract We investigate a fundamental electromagnetic theorem, namely the uniqueness theorem, in the context of nonlocal electromagnetics, as simulated by a popular semiclassical model, the Hydrodynamic Drude Model (HDM) and extensions thereof such as the Generalized Nonlocal Optical Response (GNOR).

arxiv-2402-18372.title: FedUV: Uniformity and Variance for Heterogeneous Federated Learning 1 1 1 To be presented at CVPR 2024
arxiv-2402-18372.creator: Ha Min Son, Moon-Hyun Kim, Tai-Myoung Chung, Chao Huang, Xin Liu
arxiv-2402-18372.description: Abstract Federated learning is a promising framework to train neural networks with widely distributed data. However, performance degrades heavily with heterogeneously distributed data. Recent work has shown this is due to the final layer of the network being most prone to local bias, some finding success freezing the final layer as an orthogonal classifier.

arxiv-2409-09467.title: Keeping Humans in the Loop: Human-Centered Automated Annotation with Generative AI
arxiv-2409-09467.creator: Nicholas Pangakis, Samuel Wolken
arxiv-2409-09467.description: Abstract Automated text annotation is a compelling use case for generative large language models (LLMs) in social media research. Recent work suggests that LLMs can achieve strong performance on annotation tasks; however, these studies evaluate LLMs on a small number of tasks and likely suffer from contamination due to a reliance on public benchmark datasets.

arxiv-2412-02875.title: Out-of-Distribution Detection for Neurosymbolic Autonomous Cyber Agents
arxiv-2412-02875.creator: Ankita Samaddar, Nicholas Potteiger, Xenofon Koutsoukos
arxiv-2412-02875.description: Abstract Autonomous agents for cyber applications take advantage of modern defense techniques by adopting intelligent agents with conventional and learning-enabled components. These intelligent agents are trained via reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms, and can learn, adapt to, reason about and deploy security rules to defend networked computer systems while maintaining critical operational workflows.

arxiv-2412-14861.title: Unravelling the Structures in the van der Waals Interactions of Alkali Rydberg Atoms
arxiv-2412-14861.creator: Karen Wadenpfuhl, C. Stuart Adams
arxiv-2412-14861.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Karen Wadenpfuhl, C. Stuart Adams. Rydberg atoms are used in a wide range of applications due to their peculiar properties like strong dipolar and van der Waals interactions. The choice of Rydberg state has a huge impact on the strength and angular dependence of the interactions, and so a detailed understanding of the underlying processes and resulting properties of the interactions is therefore key to select the most suitable states for experiments.

arxiv-2504-15448.title: Visualizing Public Opinion on X: A Real-Time Sentiment Dashboard Using VADER and DistilBERT
arxiv-2504-15448.creator: Y Abhiram Reddy, Siddhi Agarwal, Vikram Parashar, Arshiya Arora
arxiv-2504-15448.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Y Abhiram Reddy, Siddhi Agarwal, Vikram Parashar, Arshiya Arora. In the era of social media dominance, understanding public sentiment towards entities in real-time offers crucial insights for businesses, researchers, and policymakers [ 25 , 27 ] . This paper presents a comprehensive sentiment analysis framework leveraging both rule-based and transformer-based Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to analyze public opinion expressed on X (formerly Twitter) [ 42 , 28 ] .

arxiv-2504-19066.title: ClimaEmpact: Domain-Aligned Small Language Models and Datasets for Extreme Weather Analytics
arxiv-2504-19066.creator: Deeksha Varshney, Keane Ong, Rui Mao, Erik Cambria, Gianmarco Mengaldo
arxiv-2504-19066.description: Abstract Accurate assessments of extreme weather events are vital for research and policy, yet localized and granular data remain scarce in many parts of the world. This data gap limits our ability to analyze potential outcomes and implications of extreme weather events, hindering effective decision-making.

arxiv-2506-14773.title: Configurations in the Euclidean plane associated to a system of equations
arxiv-2506-14773.creator: Francesco Colangelo
arxiv-2506-14773.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Francesco Colangelo. In the Euclidean plane 𝐄 2 {\bf{E}}^{2} , fix four pairwise distinct points A = ( a 1 , a 2 ) , B = ( b 1 , b 2 ) , C = ( c 1 , c 2 ) , D = ( d 1 , d 2 ) , \begin{array}[]{ccc}A=(a_{1},a_{2}),\ B=(b_{1},b_{2}),\ C=(c_{1},c_{2}),\ D=(d_{1},d_{2}),\end{array} together with four non-zero real numbers k A , k B , k C , k D k_{A},k_{B},k_{C},k_{D} .

arxiv-2509-22793.title: DEFT: Decompositional Efficient Fine-Tuning for Text-to-Image Models
arxiv-2509-22793.creator: Komal Kumar, Rao Muhammad Anwer, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Salman Khan, Ivan Laptev, Hisham Cholakkal
arxiv-2509-22793.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Komal Kumar, Rao Muhammad Anwer, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Salman Khan, Ivan Laptev, Hisham Cholakkal. Efficient fine-tuning of pre-trained Text-to-Image (T2I) models involves adjusting the model to suit a particular task or dataset while minimizing computational resources and limiting the number of trainable parameters.

arxiv-2602-04090.title: Charmonium, exotic hadrons and hadron structure Talk at the International Symposium of “50 Years Discovery of the J Particle”, Beijing, October 20, 2024.
arxiv-2602-04090.creator: Bing-Song Zou
arxiv-2602-04090.description: Abstract To celebrate the 50th anniversary of the discovery of the J / ψ J/\psi , the first charmonium state observed, I start with a brief review of major progresses on the QCD inspired quark potential model originated from charmonium spectrum.

pmc-10539471.title: Marine bacteria harbor the sulfonamide resistance gene sul4 without mobile genetic elements
pmc-10539471.creator: Suzune Shindoh, Aya Kadoya, Reo Kanechi, Kozo Watanabe, Satoru Suzuki
pmc-10539471.description: Marine bacteria are possible reservoirs of antibiotic-resistance genes (ARGs) originating not only from clinical and terrestrial hot spots but also from the marine environment. We report here for the first time a higher rate of the sulfonamide-resistance gene sul4 in marine bacterial isolates compared with other sul genes.

pmc-10544178.title: Serum Uric Acid to Creatinine Ratio and Risk of Metabolic Syndrome in Patients with Overweight/Obesity
pmc-10544178.creator: Dunmin She, Wei Xu, Jing Liu, Zikai Zhang, Ping Fang, Ran Li, Dehong Kong, Miao Xuan, Qi Liu, Mo Yuan Pan, Yan Wang, Ying Xue
pmc-10544178.description: PurposeMetabolic syndrome (MetS) is a rising global concern with an increasing prevalence. This study aimed to evaluate the relationship between serum uric acid to creatinine ratio (SUA/Cr) and MetS in adults with overweight/obesity in China.Patients and MethodsWe conducted a cross-sectional study comprising 4699 participants with overweight/obesity who underwent physical examinations.

pmc-10545670.title: Midlife cardiovascular health factors as predictors of retirement age, work-loss years, and years spent in retirement among older businessmen
pmc-10545670.creator: Markus J Haapanen, Timo Törmäkangas, Monika E von Bonsdorff, Arto Y Strandberg, Timo E Strandberg, Mikaela B von Bonsdorff
pmc-10545670.description: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) is one of the leading causes of premature retirement. However, the relationship between CVD risk factors and workforce participation is not well known. We studied the relationship between midlife CVD risk, age at retirement, work-loss years, and survival in retirement. Middle-aged Finnish men (initial n = 3490, mean age = 47.

pmc-10548556.title: The effect of a tailored message package for reducing antibiotic use among respiratory tract infection patients in rural Anhui, China: a cluster randomized controlled trial protocol
pmc-10548556.creator: Rong Liu, Qun Xue, Xiaoqin Guan, Guocheng Li, Tingting Zhang, Debin Wang, Linhai Zhao, Xingrong Shen
pmc-10548556.description: BackgroundAntibiotics are over-used for patients with respiratory tract infections (RTIs) in primary care, especially in the rural areas of China.MethodsA cluster randomized controlled trial (RCT) will be carried out to estimate the effectiveness of a tailored message package for educating patients to reduce antibiotic use for symptomatic respiratory tract infections (RTIs).

pmc-10575057.title: Biodegradation of Choline NTF2 by Pantoea agglomerans in Different Osmolarity. Characterization and Environmental Implications of the Produced Exopolysaccharide
pmc-10575057.creator: Abrusci Concepción, Amils Ricardo, Sánchez-León Enrique
pmc-10575057.description: A specific microorganism, Pantoea agglomerans uam8, was isolated from the ionic liquid (IL) Choline NTF2 and identified by molecular biology. A biodegradation study was performed at osmolarity conditions (0.2, 0.6, 1.0 M). These had an important influence on the growth of the strain, exopolysaccharide (EPS) production, and biodegradation (1303 mg/L max production and 80% biodegradation at 0.6 M).

pmc-11453280.title: 7929 Immediate Read Telecytopathology Improves Diagnostic Rates Without Altering Indeterminate Rates for Thyroid Nodule Biopsy
pmc-11453280.creator: Wyatt E Lanik, Abbey Fingeret, Blake Rose, Anupam Kotwal, Ana Yuil-Valdes, Anery Patel, Whitney Goldner
pmc-11453280.description: Disclosure: W.E. Lanik: None. A. Fingeret: None. B. Rose: None. A. Kotwal: None. A. Yuil-Valdes: None. A. Patel: None. W.S. Goldner: None. Introduction: Ultrasound-guided fine-needle aspiration (FNA) is the preferred biopsy method for evaluation of thyroid nodules. Non-diagnostic and indeterminate biopsies impact patient care and healthcare cost.

pmc-12506453.creator: Arturo Villalobos Navarro, Marc Xipell, Estefanía Garduño Hernández, Ricardo Valjalo, Francisco Contreras, Andrea Ruiz de Arechavaleta, Paula Segura, Daniel Miranda, Eduardo Ávila, María José Hidalgo, Juan Daniel Diaz Garcia, Fabiola Pazos Pérez, Diana Valderrama Ávila, María Inés Gil Arredondo, Ele
pmc-12506453.description: ObjectiveLupus nephritis (LN) is associated with a poorer prognosis in Latin American populations. However, the contributing risk factors contributing to this remain to be fully elucidated. This study aimed to develop a prognostic model for poor renal outcomes in patients of mestizo descent.

pmc-13157142.title: Dietary selenium intake and asthma in US children and adolescents
pmc-13157142.creator: Lingyu Li, Shuai Wang, Hongyan Wei, Changcheng Sun
pmc-13157142.description: ObjectiveEvidence concerning total dietary selenium intake in the US pediatric population remains sparse and inconsistent. This study employs a nationally representative dataset to investigate the association between selenium intake and asthma prevalence, addressing this critical knowledge gap.MethodThe National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) (2011–2020) furnished data on asthmatic individuals aged < 20 years with quantified dietary selenium intake.

pmc-13589390.title: Infectious pathogens associated with stillbirth and under-five mortality by sickle cell disease in Western Kenya: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13589390.creator: Morgan Otundo Wasilwa, Valentine Simiyu, Fredrick Onduru, Edwin Kiplelgo, Maryann Nyanjom, Kephas Otieno, Hellen Muttai, Richard Omore, Victor Akelo, Dorcas Obiri-Yeboah
pmc-13589390.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundInfectious Pathogens (IP) remain a significant contributor to stillbirths and under-five deaths in resource-limited settings. Children with sickle cell disease (SCD) are susceptible due to weakened immunity, influencing infection outcomes. This sub-study, nested within the Kenya Child Health and Mortality Prevention Surveillance (CHAMPS) network, investigated infectious pathogens associated with stillbirths and under-five deaths in Western Kenya, as well as the role of the sickle cell condition.MethodsWe analysed stillbirths (n = 387) and ≤ 5 child deaths (n = 945) enrolled in CHAMPS

pmc-13653190.title: Analysis of Postoperative Quality of Life in Patients With Acute Type A Aortic Dissection After Extensive Arch Repair via Partial Upper Sternotomy
pmc-13653190.creator: Linfeng Xie, Xiujuan Wang, Zhaofeng Zhang, Debin Jiang, Xinfan Lin
pmc-13653190.description: Background:This study aimed to compare health-related quality of life (HRQoL) in patients with acute type A aortic dissection (AAAD) who underwent extensive arch repair via partial upper sternotomy (PUS) or full median sternotomy (FS).Methods:Data were collected from 112 patients with AAAD who were divided into two groups based on the surgical approach.
